## Behavior

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. For an intentional behavior change,
state the old and new result, including affected displays or stored configuration.

## Implementation

Name the owning subsystem and any compatibility or migration implications.

## Validation

List actual commands and results. Separate native desktop checks from automated
tests; identify failures, skips and checks not run. For documentation-only changes,
report documentation checks instead.

## Remaining limitations

State unresolved issues or write “None identified within this change's scope.”
